purpose: Route a11y, WCAG, keyboard, ARIA, and screen-reader work here instead of general frontend, visual polish, or iOS keychain-accessibility review.

cases.prompt: fix a11y so a screen reader can operate this dialog
make this dialog work with keyboard navigation and a visible focus ring
does this form meet WCAG for labels and screen readers
add an ARIA accessible name to these icon buttons
split this page into presentational and container components
make this landing page look less AI-generated
wire this form to React Query and keep the mutation state in the container
